Local Differential Privacy (LDP) [64] is a variant of DP where privacy is ensured by adding noise to individual data points before they are collected or aggregated. This approach protects individual data entries even when an untrusted aggregator is involved. And Generalized Randomized Response (GRR) [38] is a key mechanism for achieving LDP by introducing randomness into individual responses. For each element 𝑒, the function 𝜙 maps it to a random integer 𝑖 uniformly selected from {0, 1, . . . , 𝑚 − 1}.
